stem: 9. Find the number of subsets and the number of proper subsets of the following sets.

entries.question: W = {red, blue, yellow}
steps: The set W has three distinct colours, so n(W) = 3.
Every element may independently be included or excluded, yielding 2³ = 8 subsets.
Exactly one subset equals W itself, so the number of proper subsets is 8 − 1 = 7.
entries.answer: Number of subsets = 8; number of proper subsets = 7.
entries.mathCheck: Enumerated subset counts by binomial coefficients 1+3+3+1=8; exclude the full set.

entries.question: X = { x² : x ∈ N , x² ≤ 100}
steps: Since x is a natural number and x² ≤ 100, x ranges from 1 through 10 (zero is not included in N).
The number of subsets is 2¹⁰ = 1024; excluding X itself leaves 1023 proper subsets.
entries.answer: Number of subsets = 1024; number of proper subsets = 1023.
